segments.text: There's a lot going on in our laboratories.
segments.zh: 我们的实验室里有很多事情在进行。

segments.text: Sometimes it's hard to keep on top of it all.
segments.zh: 有时候很难把一切都掌控好。

segments.text: And when you have your hands full,
segments.zh: 当你手头忙得不可开交，

segments.text: just making sure everything's running right,
segments.zh: 光是确保一切正常运转，

segments.text: it can be easy to forget
segments.zh: 就很容易忘记

segments.text: that you have to think about safety too.
segments.zh: 你还得考虑安全。

segments.text: But safety is important,
segments.zh: 但安全很重要，

segments.text: because if you're not careful,
segments.zh: 因为如果你不小心，

segments.text: the laboratory can be a pretty dangerous place.
segments.zh: 实验室可能是个相当危险的地方。

segments.text: We're all human, no matter how many years of school
segments.zh: 我们都是凡人，无论读了多少年书

segments.text: or work we have under our belts.
segments.zh: 或有多少年的工作经验。

segments.text: And when things get hectic,
segments.zh: 当事情变得手忙脚乱时，

segments.text: we often suffer from an overwhelming urge
segments.zh: 我们常常会有一种难以抗拒的冲动，

segments.text: to do the wrong thing,
segments.zh: 去做错误的事情，

segments.text: to take shortcuts and ignore safety precautions.
segments.zh: 走捷径，无视安全防范措施。

segments.text: So if you're new to your lab,
segments.zh: 所以如果你刚来到你的实验室，

segments.text: while you're learning where the light switches are,
segments.zh: 在了解电灯开关在哪里的同时，

segments.text: you should also learn the safety rules.
segments.zh: 你也应该学习安全规则。

segments.text: There's a wealth of safety information you should know.
segments.zh: 你应该了解的安全信息有很多。

segments.text: You need to learn about safety data sheets, SDSs,
segments.zh: 你需要了解安全技术说明书，也就是 SDS，

segments.text: which describe a substance's ingredients,
segments.zh: 它描述了一种物质的成分、

segments.text: properties, and hazards.
segments.zh: 性质和危害。

segments.text: And there's your facility's chemical hygiene plan,
segments.zh: 还有你们设施的化学品卫生计划，

segments.text: which explains how to work with the chemicals
segments.zh: 它说明了如何在你们实验室里

segments.text: in your lab safely.
segments.zh: 安全地使用化学品。

segments.text: In fact, there are plans covering all types of hazards,
segments.zh: 事实上，有涵盖各类危害的计划，

segments.text: including biologically infectious materials.
segments.zh: 包括具有生物感染性的物质。

segments.text: You may read about things such as RCRA,
segments.zh: 你可能会读到诸如 RCRA、

segments.text: lockout, tag-out, and respiratory protection.
segments.zh: 上锁挂牌以及呼吸防护之类的内容。

segments.text: You could also take courses
segments.zh: 你还可以参加课程，

segments.text: on how to use fire extinguishers,
segments.zh: 学习如何使用灭火器、

segments.text: perform first aid and CPR,
segments.zh: 进行急救和心肺复苏，

segments.text: and other important topics as well.
segments.zh: 以及其他重要的主题。

segments.text: But remember, the courses and written plans
segments.zh: 但要记住，课程和书面计划

segments.text: are only sources of information.
segments.zh: 只是信息来源。

segments.text: You're the one who has to put the knowledge
segments.zh: 要把它们给你的知识付诸实践的，

segments.text: they give you to work.
segments.zh: 是你自己。

segments.text: The ultimate responsibility to be safe lies with you.
segments.zh: 保证安全的最终责任在于你。

segments.text: You should start by planning out your work carefully.
segments.zh: 首先，你应该仔细规划你的工作。

segments.text: Assemble all of the materials and SDSs
segments.zh: 提前准备好你将需要的所有材料

segments.text: you'll need ahead of time.
segments.zh: 和安全技术说明书。

segments.text: Remember your personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 记住你的个人防护装备，

segments.text: You'll often hear it referred to as PPE.
segments.zh: 你会经常听到它被称为 PPE。

segments.text: Select it based on the chemicals and procedures
segments.zh: 根据你将使用的化学品和操作程序

segments.text: you'll be using.
segments.zh: 来选择它。

segments.text: Each lab has rules about which areas require PPE,
segments.zh: 每个实验室对于哪些区域需要穿戴个人防护装备都有规定，

segments.text: so you'll need to know this as well.
segments.zh: 所以你也需要了解这一点。

segments.text: Make sure you know where to find it.
segments.zh: 确保你知道在哪里可以找到它。

segments.text: PPE is often stored in a central location.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备通常存放在一个集中的地方。

segments.text: Any PPE that you need will be supplied at no cost to you.
segments.zh: 你需要的任何个人防护装备都会免费提供给你。

segments.text: There are many types of PPE.
segments.zh: 个人防护装备有很多种类。

segments.text: Eyewear ranging from safety glasses
segments.zh: 从安全眼镜到面罩的

segments.text: to face shields is particularly important.
segments.zh: 眼部防护用品尤其重要。

segments.text: Be sure to wear the type or combination
segments.zh: 一定要佩戴适合你所做工作的

segments.text: that's right for the job you're doing.
segments.zh: 类型或组合。

segments.text: And remember, regular street glasses are not acceptable.
segments.zh: 还要记住，普通的日常眼镜是不行的。

segments.text: Lab coats are also personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 实验服也是个人防护装备。

segments.text: They help shield you from accidental slashes.
segments.zh: 它们有助于保护你免受意外飞溅。

segments.text: Wearing the proper gloves is important as well.
segments.zh: 佩戴合适的手套也很重要。

segments.text: Choose them according to the hazards associated
segments.zh: 根据与你所用材料和设备相关的危害

segments.text: with the materials and equipment you're using.
segments.zh: 来选择手套。

segments.text: Check with your supervisor
segments.zh: 向你的主管确认

segments.text: as to whether you'll need to use a respirator.
segments.zh: 你是否需要使用呼吸器。

segments.text: If your work demands one,
segments.zh: 如果你的工作需要呼吸器，

segments.text: it's important that you be properly trained and fit tested.
segments.zh: 你就必须接受正规培训并进行适合性测试，这一点很重要。

segments.text: A respirator that doesn't fit properly won't protect you.
segments.zh: 不合适的呼吸器保护不了你。

segments.text: Air purifying respirators, APRs, are the most common.
segments.zh: 空气净化式呼吸器，也就是 APR，是最常见的。

segments.text: They use chemical cartridges to trap contaminants
segments.zh: 它们用化学滤盒在你吸入污染物之前

segments.text: before you breathe them in.
segments.zh: 把它们截留下来。

segments.text: A self-contained breathing apparatus, SCBA,
segments.zh: 自给式空气呼吸器，也就是 SCBA，

segments.text: is only used in extreme situations.
segments.zh: 只在极端情况下使用。

segments.text: They're sophisticated pieces of equipment
segments.zh: 它们是精密的设备，

segments.text: and you shouldn't put one on
segments.zh: 除非你接受过使用指导，

segments.text: unless you've been instructed in their use.
segments.zh: 否则不应该佩戴。

segments.text: Wear sensible shoes in the lab, no open toes,
segments.zh: 在实验室里要穿合适的鞋，不要露脚趾，

segments.text: closed leather shoes keep spilled chemicals off your feet.
segments.zh: 封闭的皮鞋能防止溅出的化学品沾到脚上。

segments.text: Many labs require safety shoes
segments.zh: 许多实验室要求穿安全鞋，

segments.text: with special soles and protective toe plates.
segments.zh: 带有特殊鞋底和防护趾板。

segments.text: Check all personal protective equipment before using it.
segments.zh: 在使用之前检查所有个人防护装备。

segments.text: If PPE is cracked or worn, it won't be effective,
segments.zh: 如果个人防护装备有裂纹或磨损，就起不到作用，

segments.text: so get it repaired or discarded.
segments.zh: 所以要拿去修理或丢弃。

segments.text: Remember to remove your lab coat and other PPE
segments.zh: 记得脱下实验服和其他个人防护装备，

segments.text: before leaving the lab area.
segments.zh: 再离开实验室区域。

segments.text: And wash your hands.
segments.zh: 还要洗手。

segments.text: You don't want to take contamination with you.
segments.zh: 你可不想把污染带走。

segments.text: It's important for the apparatus and equipment
segments.zh: 你在操作中将使用的器具和设备

segments.text: you'll be using in your procedures to be safe as well.
segments.zh: 也必须是安全的，这很重要。

segments.text: Check each piece before setting it up.
segments.zh: 在安装之前检查每一件。

segments.text: Everything should be clean and in proper working order.
segments.zh: 所有东西都应该干净，并且处于正常工作状态。

segments.text: Glassware that is chipped or cracked must be replaced.
segments.zh: 有缺口或裂纹的玻璃仪器必须更换。

segments.text: Any amount of pressure could shatter it.
segments.zh: 任何一点压力都可能让它碎裂。

segments.text: If your work requires specialized equipment or containers,
segments.zh: 如果你的工作需要专门的设备或容器，

segments.text: use them.
segments.zh: 就使用它们。

segments.text: Makeshift substitutes can be dangerous.
segments.zh: 临时凑合的替代品可能很危险。

segments.text: Work to keep your lab clean and clutter-free.
segments.zh: 努力保持实验室干净、不杂乱。

segments.text: Report and correct any unsafe conditions.
segments.zh: 报告并纠正任何不安全的状况。

segments.text: Misplaced equipment or furniture can cause trips and falls.
segments.zh: 放错位置的设备或家具可能导致绊倒和摔倒。

segments.text: Move it to a more suitable area.
segments.zh: 把它挪到更合适的地方。

segments.text: You also need to know how to use ventilation controls,
segments.zh: 你还需要知道如何使用通风控制设施，

segments.text: such as lab hoods.
segments.zh: 比如实验室通风柜。

segments.text: When it's working correctly,
segments.zh: 当它正常运行时，

segments.text: the airflow within an exhaust hood effectively confines
segments.zh: 排风通风柜内的气流能有效地限制

segments.text: and removes released vapors.
segments.zh: 并排除释放出的蒸气。

segments.text: An invisible curtain of air blows across the opening
segments.zh: 一道看不见的空气帘幕吹过开口，

segments.text: and keeps vapors from escaping under the sash.
segments.zh: 防止蒸气从柜门下方逸出。

segments.text: But you still need to keep the sash as low as possible.
segments.zh: 但你仍然需要让柜门尽可能低。

segments.text: Never interfere with the airflow in a hood.
segments.zh: 绝不要干扰通风柜内的气流。

segments.text: This will reduce its effectiveness
segments.zh: 这会降低它的效能，

segments.text: and could allow contaminated air
segments.zh: 并可能让受污染的空气

segments.text: to make it into your breathing zone.
segments.zh: 进入你的呼吸区。

segments.text: There are many types of lab hoods,
segments.zh: 实验室通风柜有很多种类，

segments.text: so make sure you're using the right one
segments.zh: 所以要确保你使用的是

segments.text: for the process you're running.
segments.zh: 适合你所进行的操作的那一种。

segments.text: For instance, biological safety cabinets
segments.zh: 例如，生物安全柜

segments.text: can find any potentially infectious aerosols,
segments.zh: 能够限制任何可能具有感染性的气溶胶，

segments.text: but might not be appropriate for industrial chemicals.
segments.zh: 但可能不适合用于工业化学品。

segments.text: Be sure to test any hood you'll be using
segments.zh: 一定要测试你将使用的任何通风柜，

segments.text: to make certain it's operating the way it should.
segments.zh: 确保它按应有的方式运行。

segments.text: And remember to work at least six inches inside the hood.
segments.zh: 还要记得在通风柜内至少六英寸处操作。

segments.text: Storing your chemicals properly is extremely important.
segments.zh: 正确地储存化学品极其重要。

segments.text: Try not to use benchtops or hoods as storage areas.
segments.zh: 尽量不要把实验台面或通风柜当作储存区。

segments.text: Containers in these locations are too easy to knock over
segments.zh: 放在这些地方的容器太容易被碰倒，

segments.text: and are unprotected from accidental fires.
segments.zh: 而且无法防护意外火灾。

segments.text: Collect small quantities of flammables
segments.zh: 把少量的易燃物收集在

segments.text: in UL-listed containers with spring-loaded caps.
segments.zh: 经 UL 认证、带弹簧盖的容器中。

segments.text: Place amounts greater than one liter
segments.zh: 超过一升的量

segments.text: in flammable storage cabinets.
segments.zh: 要放进易燃品储存柜。

segments.text: There are special regulations governing the use
segments.zh: 有专门的规定管理着

segments.text: of compressed gas cylinders.
segments.zh: 压缩气瓶的使用。

segments.text: Cylinders should be located away
segments.zh: 气瓶应放置在远离

segments.text: from any sources of flames or sparks.
segments.zh: 任何火焰或火花源的地方。

segments.text: Strap or chain them to benches or walls
segments.zh: 用绑带或链条把它们固定在实验台或墙上，

segments.text: so they won't fall and hoses won't rip free.
segments.zh: 这样它们就不会倒下，软管也不会被扯脱。

segments.text: Ask your supervisor about the number of cylinders
segments.zh: 向你的主管询问

segments.text: that can be safely stored in your lab.
segments.zh: 你们实验室可以安全存放的气瓶数量。

segments.text: Knowing exactly what you're working with
segments.zh: 确切地知道你在使用什么，

segments.text: is essential in a lab environment.
segments.zh: 在实验室环境中至关重要。

segments.text: All chemical containers must be correctly labeled
segments.zh: 所有化学品容器都必须正确标识，

segments.text: so that anyone who uses them
segments.zh: 以便任何使用它们的人

segments.text: will be able to tell what's in them.
segments.zh: 都能分辨出里面是什么。

segments.text: ACN may mean acrylonitrile to you, a potent carcinogen.
segments.zh: ACN 对你来说可能意味着丙烯腈，一种强致癌物。

segments.text: But to someone from outside your lab,
segments.zh: 但对于你们实验室以外的人来说，

segments.text: ACN may indicate acetone-a-trill, a common solvent.
segments.zh: ACN 可能表示乙腈，一种常见的溶剂。

segments.text: Writing out the proper name of a substance
segments.zh: 写出物质的正式名称，

segments.text: will also allow others to easily locate
segments.zh: 也能让其他人轻松找到

segments.text: the chemical safety data sheet.
segments.zh: 该化学品的安全技术说明书。

segments.text: Some experimental compounds may never have a written SDS.
segments.zh: 有些实验性化合物可能永远不会有书面的安全技术说明书。

segments.text: This doesn't mean there isn't a hazard.
segments.zh: 这并不意味着没有危害。

segments.text: Make sure to determine the material's properties
segments.zh: 一定要确定该物质的性质，

segments.text: and take all the necessary precautions.
segments.zh: 并采取一切必要的预防措施。

segments.text: Unauthorized experimentation, though, is never permitted.
segments.zh: 不过，未经授权的实验是绝不允许的。

segments.text: If an accident occurred and you weren't in the lab,
segments.zh: 如果发生了事故而你不在实验室，

segments.text: no one would know how to handle it.
segments.zh: 就没有人知道该如何处理。

segments.text: What to do with chemical and infectious waste
segments.zh: 如何处理化学废物和感染性废物，

segments.text: is another thing you need to know about.
segments.zh: 是你需要了解的另一件事。

segments.text: Your facility has a written policy
segments.zh: 你们设施有一份书面规定，

segments.text: on how to handle this type of material.
segments.zh: 说明如何处理这类物质。

segments.text: Plan for how you'll dispose of any waste
segments.zh: 计划好你将如何处置任何废物，

segments.text: before you begin your work.
segments.zh: 要在开始工作之前。

segments.text: A mistake in disposal could cause serious problems
segments.zh: 处置上的失误可能会对公共健康和环境

segments.text: with public health and the environment
segments.zh: 造成严重问题，

segments.text: and could subject your lab to harsh criminal
segments.zh: 并可能使你们实验室受到严厉的刑事

segments.text: and civil penalties.
segments.zh: 和民事处罚。

segments.text: Ask your supervisor or safety manager
segments.zh: 请询问你的主管或安全经理，

segments.text: if you have any questions.
segments.zh: 如果你有任何疑问的话。

segments.text: If there's an accident in your lab,
segments.zh: 如果你们实验室发生事故，

segments.text: it's vital that you know what to do.
segments.zh: 知道该怎么做是至关重要的。

segments.text: Review your facility's emergency procedures.
segments.zh: 复习你们设施的应急程序。

segments.text: You may need to dial 911
segments.zh: 你可能需要拨打 911，

segments.text: or alert on-site emergency responders.
segments.zh: 或通知现场应急响应人员。

segments.text: Walk every inch of your evacuation routes.
segments.zh: 把你的疏散路线一寸一寸地走一遍。

segments.text: It's important to know what areas you'll be going through.
segments.zh: 了解你将经过哪些区域很重要。

segments.text: Talk to your supervisor about the emergency systems
segments.zh: 和你的主管谈谈应急系统

segments.text: and fire alarms in your labs.
segments.zh: 以及你们实验室的火灾报警器。

segments.text: Knowing the location of emergency equipment
segments.zh: 知道应急设备的位置，

segments.text: like fire extinguishers and spill cleanup kits
segments.zh: 比如灭火器和溅洒清理包，

segments.text: is also important.
segments.zh: 也很重要。

segments.text: But if you aren't trained, don't try to use them.
segments.zh: 但如果你没有受过培训，就不要尝试使用它们。

segments.text: Remember, the watchword of safety
segments.zh: 记住，安全的座右铭

segments.text: is always life over property.
segments.zh: 永远是生命高于财产。

segments.text: Be prepared to deal with a chemical spill.
segments.zh: 做好应对化学品溅洒的准备。

segments.text: If it's a flammable substance,
segments.zh: 如果是易燃物质，

segments.text: turn off all sources of ignition.
segments.zh: 就关闭所有点火源。

segments.text: Know the locations of eye washes and safety showers
segments.zh: 知道洗眼器和紧急喷淋的位置，

segments.text: as well as how to use them.
segments.zh: 以及如何使用它们。

segments.text: If you come into contact with a chemical,
segments.zh: 如果你接触到了化学品，

segments.text: remember to flush the affected area with water
segments.zh: 记得用水冲洗受影响的部位

segments.text: for at least 15 minutes.
segments.zh: 至少 15 分钟。

segments.text: Then report the incident and call for medical help.
segments.zh: 然后报告事件并呼叫医疗救助。

segments.text: Coming into a new lab can be both exciting and stressful.
segments.zh: 来到一个新的实验室，可能既令人兴奋又让人紧张。

segments.text: There are new people to meet,
segments.zh: 要认识新的人，

segments.text: new materials to work with, and new procedures to learn.
segments.zh: 要使用新的材料，要学习新的操作程序。

segments.text: But most importantly, you'll need to learn
segments.zh: 但最重要的是，你需要学会

segments.text: how to do your work safely.
segments.zh: 如何安全地开展工作。

segments.text: Let's review.
segments.zh: 我们来回顾一下。

segments.text: Know what materials you'll be working with
segments.zh: 知道你将使用哪些物质，

segments.text: and where to find their SDSs.
segments.zh: 以及在哪里可以找到它们的安全技术说明书。

segments.text: Be familiar with your lab's chemical hygiene plan.
segments.zh: 熟悉你们实验室的化学品卫生计划。

segments.text: Know what personal protective equipment you'll need
segments.zh: 知道你需要哪些个人防护装备，

segments.text: and how to use it.
segments.zh: 以及如何使用它们。

segments.text: Check the equipment and apparatus you'll be using.
segments.zh: 检查你将使用的设备和器具，

segments.text: Make sure it's functioning correctly.
segments.zh: 确保它们运行正常。

segments.text: Keep your work area clean and clutter free.
segments.zh: 保持你的工作区域干净、不杂乱。

segments.text: And know what to do in an emergency.
segments.zh: 并知道在紧急情况下该怎么做。

segments.text: Every laboratory has its hazards,
segments.zh: 每个实验室都有它的危害，

segments.text: but if you pay attention to your supervisor
segments.zh: 但只要你听从主管的指导，

segments.text: and know the rules, you'll be able to work safely
segments.zh: 并了解规则，你就能安全地工作，

segments.text: all day, every day.
segments.zh: 每一天，每时每刻。
